instanceNote: Uniboost instance of existing OPEN ledger L-06 (342075df). Annotate the existing L-06 entry; DO NOT mint a duplicate finding/label.
title: pool()/unlockCallback single-sided LP-add relies solely on off-chain keeper min floors with no on-chain price reference (MEV sandwich) -- Uniboost instance of L-06
description: Uniboost pool() buy-and-pool single-sided LP-add relies on off-chain keeper-supplied minPairOut/minTargetOut and a post-call minLP floor, with no on-chain oracle/TWAP reference. Same root-cause class as OPEN ledger L-06 (BalancerPoolerV2.pool). Second observed instance on the new Uniboost dispatcher.
impact: Bounded MEV slippage on protocol-owned-liquidity (POL) LP adds; not user funds; operator-triggered; bounded by the supplied floors + minLP.
attackPath: 1. Authorized pooler calls pool() with off-chain-computed min floors.
2. A sandwicher manipulates the pool around the add within the slack between the off-chain floor and true price (no on-chain oracle/TWAP reference).
3. The add executes at a worse rate; the delta is captured by the MEV bot, bounded by the supplied floors + minLP.
recommendation: Same as L-06: introduce an on-chain price reference (oracle/TWAP) to bound the single-sided add beyond off-chain keeper floors.
dedupNote: Same class as open L-06. Reuses L-06 fingerprint (342075df) as a second instance; NOT a regression (L-06 is open, not fixed). Annotate L-06 with the Uniboost instance.
